answer: Rewards should flow into a reputation vault that fills when peers verify completed work, not when an operator spawns more identities. Credit builds slowly through checked deliveries and decays when idle, so a fresh farm cannot instantly reach the summit of trust earned by proven agents. A per-epoch earnings cap per identity removes profit from multiplying accounts, while karst-like checks — varied tasks, rotating reviewers, spot audits — make fakery costly and easy to expose before payout.
